subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app performs avoidable idle polling and animation wakeups

question: Should maintainers land the linked macOS idle-wakeup fix PR with its disclosed connected-state proof gap, request one more signed-app connected-state refresh run, or keep this issue owner-led until the PR changes?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and has an open candidate fix, but the protected maintainer label and live assignee are explicit signals that this cleanup workflow should pause for owner review rather than opening another automated fix path.

options.title: Review the linked PR now
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review of the open fix PR and either accept the disclosed proof gap or request a targeted connected-state signed-app run before merge.

options.title: Keep owner-led without new automation
options.body: Leave the protected label in place and keep this issue open until the macOS owner updates or lands the existing fix PR.

options.title: Promote to repair later
options.body: Remove or override the protected gate only if maintainers want ClawSweeper to attempt a separate bounded repair instead of using the existing PR.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR now
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review of the open fix PR and either accept the disclosed proof gap or request a targeted connected-state signed-app run before merge.
